fileNodes.name: CancelResult.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable record describing the outcome of a cancel (status, order id, cancelled quantity), with validation and factory methods; an unknown order is a normal return value, not an exception (D17).

fileNodes.name: CancelStatus.java
fileNodes.summary: Enum of cancel outcomes: CANCELLED or UNKNOWN_ORDER, where not owning an order deliberately maps to UNKNOWN_ORDER (D48).

fileNodes.name: LevelUpdate.java
fileNodes.summary: Record for level-2 market data: the side, price, total volume and order count of one price level after a command; volume 0 means the level is gone.

fileNodes.name: ExchangeClient.java
fileNodes.summary: Minimal blocking client for the line protocol used by ClientMain and the gateway tests; a background reader thread queues lines and await() finds matching lines while keeping skipped ones for later lookups.

fileNodes.name: OutputDigest.java
fileNodes.summary: Running FNV-1a 64 digest over a canonical, field-by-field text encoding of every engine output (D70), written into journal CHECK records so replay divergence after a behaviour change is detected.

fileNodes.name: OutputListener.java
fileNodes.summary: Functional interface invoked on the writer thread with each command's engine output and numbered private events, before the request future completes (D76); implemented by the gateway and never called during replay.

fileNodes.name: OutputLog.java
fileNodes.summary: Numbers each participant's private events (oseq) deterministically from engine outputs and retains the most recent ones per participant to serve RESEND requests (D73); can resume numbering from a snapshot.

fileNodes.name: PrivateEvent.java
fileNodes.summary: Sealed interface for a participant's private stream messages (D73): OrderReply, CancelReply and MakerFill records, each numbered per participant so replay rebuilds identical oseq numbering.

fileNodes.name: CancelAllOutput.java
fileNodes.summary: Engine output record for a CANCEL_ALL (D72): one CANCELLED result per removed order in book priority order plus the resulting level updates; never contains trades or fills.

fileNodes.name: CancelOutput.java
fileNodes.summary: Engine output record for a single cancel command: the CancelResult and level updates, with empty trade and passive-fill lists.

fileNodes.name: EngineOutput.java
fileNodes.summary: Sealed interface for everything one command produced: sequence number, timestamp, trades, passive fills and level updates, separating private results from public market data.

fileNodes.name: Execution.java
fileNodes.summary: Record for a fill on a resting (passive) order addressed to its owner, the only way the maker learns about its fills.

fileNodes.name: OrderOutput.java
fileNodes.summary: Engine output record for a new order: the Response (whose trades are exposed as the output's trades), passive fills and level updates.

fileNodes.name: Reason.java
fileNodes.summary: Enum of state-dependent reasons a new order did not simply trade and rest (duplicate client order id, price band, open-order and book caps, post-only cross, self-trade prevention), with isReject() distinguishing rejects from SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED cancels.

fileNodes.name: Trade.java
fileNodes.summary: Validated record of one trade: resting-level price, quantity, both order ids, aggressor side and the incoming command's timestamp (D34, keeps replay deterministic).

fileNodes.name: Protocol.java
fileNodes.summary: Defines and implements the ASCII line wire protocol (D53): parses client messages (LOGIN, NEW, CANCEL, RESEND, SUBSCRIBE, ...) and formats server lines (FILL, ORDER, CANCELLED, BOOK, TRADE, LEVEL, ERROR); its header comment is the protocol reference.

fileNodes.name: TcpGateway.java
fileNodes.summary: Thread-per-connection TCP/TLS gateway that accepts sessions, authenticates logins, enforces session limits (D74, D75) and, as the exchange's OutputListener, routes private events to the participant's sessions and market data to subscribers; triggers cancel-on-disconnect.

fileNodes.name: OutputDigestTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Unit tests for OutputDigest: identical outputs give identical digests, every output kind and every field contributes, cancel results are included, and the digest resumes from its hex form.

fileNodes.name: OutputLogTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Unit tests for OutputLog: per-participant oseq numbering with requester first, CANCEL_ALL numbering, retention limits, resume after snapshot, and rejecting a mismatched command/output pair.

fileNodes.name: ProtocolTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Unit tests for Protocol grouped into Parse and Format: parsing valid and malformed client lines and formatting every server line type.

fileNodes.name: TcpGatewayTest.java
fileNodes.summary: End-to-end gateway tests over real sockets using ExchangeClient and a journalled ExchangeService, grouped into Session, Security, Limits, Trading, Resend, CancelOnDisconnect and MarketData behaviours, including restart persistence.

fileNodes.name: ExchangeException.java
fileNodes.summary: Defines the runtime exception callers receive when a request gets no business result, with a Reason enum (BUSY, STOPPED, HALTED, INTERNAL_ERROR) that tells them whether to retry, resend, or give up.

fileNodes.name: ExchangeService.java
fileNodes.summary: Implements the single-writer thread model: any caller thread hands requests into one queue, and the dedicated 'exchange-writer' thread drains them in smart batches (or linger group-commit) and calls Exchange.process, journalling with one fsync per batch. Manages the RUNNING/STOPPING/STOPPED/HALTED lifecycle under one lock so no accepted request is ever lost.

fileNodes.name: Request.java
fileNodes.summary: Sealed interface of records describing what a caller hands to the writer queue before stamping: Submit, Cancel, CancelAll (journalled commands) and Snapshot, Attach, Resend (unjournalled reads), each typed by its result.

fileNodes.name: ResendResult.java
fileNodes.summary: Record answering a RESEND request with retained private events, the first still-retained output sequence number, and the participant's latest one (D73).

fileNodes.name: OrderRequest.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable client order before stamping and the only stateless validation layer (D19): checks participant and client order id patterns, quantity and price limits from Rules, and that market orders carry no price. Reused by the gateway and the journal decoder.

fileNodes.name: BookSnapshot.java
fileNodes.summary: Record of the book as of a command: last processed sequence number, last trade price, and best-first bid/ask level lists that a market-data subscriber starts from.

fileNodes.name: OrderStatus.java
fileNodes.summary: Enum of the four outcomes of a new order (FILLED, RESTED, CANCELLED, REJECTED), each implying a different next action for the client (D23).

fileNodes.name: Response.java
fileNodes.summary: Record telling a submitter the result of a new order (D22): order id, status, reason, filled/remaining quantities and own trades, with a constructor that enforces consistency invariants so engine bugs fail before reaching a client.

fileNodes.name: ClientSession.java
fileNodes.summary: One TCP client connection with a reader thread (parse, LOGIN authentication, stateless checks, in-flight cap and token-bucket rate limit) and a sender thread draining a bounded outbound queue; closes only after every handed-in request completes (D74-D76).

fileNodes.name: MainTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Tests Main's startup failure hints: a corrupt journal gets no poison-pill advice, and a replay CHECK divergence gets the --compact advice.

fileNodes.name: BatchingBenchmark.java
fileNodes.summary: JMH benchmark comparing fsync-per-command, linger-1ms group commit and smart batching of ExchangeService under closed-loop clients (D37, D52).

fileNodes.name: SequencerTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Tests Sequencer stamping, that invalid input consumes no ids or sequence numbers, clock handling (including backwards clocks), resume after replay, and command validation.

fileNodes.name: ExchangeServiceTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Concurrent tests of ExchangeService: hand-in, stop semantics, backpressure, writer failures, batching and robustness, using a Gate CommandInterceptor to block the writer deterministically.

fileNodes.name: ExchangeTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Tests the Exchange facade: live path, restart and recovery, poison-pill quarantine, CHECK checkpoints, compaction to snapshots, and operations.

fileNodes.name: MutableClock.java
fileNodes.summary: Thread-safe test Clock that can be set or advanced (including backwards), shared by sequencer, exchange and service tests to control timestamps deterministically.

fileNodes.name: OrderBook.java
fileNodes.summary: Owns the lifecycle of every resting order: bid/ask TreeMaps of PriceLevels plus an id map and per-participant open counts, with all mutations funneled through add, fillBest and cancel so the book invariants hold in one place.

fileNodes.name: OrderNode.java
fileNodes.summary: Package-private doubly linked list node holding an Order inside a PriceLevel; a null order marks a sentinel, enforced by construction.

fileNodes.name: PriceLevel.java
fileNodes.summary: Time-priority queue of orders at one price on one side, implemented as a sentinel-bounded doubly linked list; public read-only state, package-private mutators so only OrderBook can change it.

fileNodes.name: CancelAllCommand.java
fileNodes.summary: Journalled command record that cancels every resting order of one participant (cancel-on-disconnect, D72), validating sequence number and participant in its compact constructor.

fileNodes.name: CancelOrderCommand.java
fileNodes.summary: Journalled command record that cancels one resting order by its exchange order id, validating sequence number, participant and target id.

fileNodes.name: Ledger.java
fileNodes.summary: Writer-thread-owned bundle of everything derived from commands (matching engine, output digest, per-participant output log), built from a snapshot and rebuilt as one unit on poison-pill recovery.

fileNodes.name: Order.java
fileNodes.summary: Accepted order domain object: a validated OrderRequest plus sequencer-issued id and timestamp, tracking filled and remaining quantity with no knowledge of where it is stored.

fileNodes.name: Rules.java
fileNodes.summary: Central registry of every rule replay depends on (rules VERSION, quantity/price limits, id patterns, price band, open-order and book caps) plus the exact-integer price band check.

fileNodes.name: MatchingEngine.java
fileNodes.summary: Deterministic price-time-priority matching engine for one instrument: runs side-effect-free pre-checks (duplicate id, price band, caps, FOK fillability, post-only), the shared matching loop with self-trade prevention, and per-OrderType outcomes, delegating book mutations to OrderBook.

fileNodes.name: MatchingBenchmark.java
fileNodes.summary: JMH benchmark measuring best-level lookup, rest-and-take and add-and-cancel costs of the engine at 10, 1000 and 100000 price levels per side.

fileNodes.name: OrderBookTest.java
fileNodes.summary: JUnit tests for OrderBook organised in @Nested groups (add, fillBest, cancel, open orders, level updates, walk) plus an invariant check under randomized traffic.

fileNodes.name: MatchingEngineTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Extensive JUnit suite for MatchingEngine covering limit, IOC, FOK, market and post-only orders, cancels, risk bands, self-trade prevention, caps, cancel-all, snapshots, outputs, guards and determinism.

fileNodes.name: CheckCommand.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable CHECK checkpoint record (D70) carrying the 16-hex-digit output digest of all prior commands; replay compares it against its own digest instead of feeding it to the engine.

fileNodes.name: Command.java
fileNodes.summary: Sealed interface for every stamped, journalled input command (NEW, CANCEL, CANCEL_ALL, SKIP, CHECK), exposing sequence number and timestamp as the source of truth for replay.

fileNodes.name: NewOrderCommand.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable NEW command record binding a validated OrderRequest to its sequencer-issued sequence number, timestamp and order id.

fileNodes.name: SkipCommand.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable SKIP command record that quarantines an earlier poison-pill command (D51) so replay does not feed it, annotating rather than editing history.

fileNodes.name: CommandInterceptor.java
fileNodes.summary: Package-private functional-interface test seam invoked just before the engine processes each command, live and in replay; production uses the no-op NONE.

fileNodes.name: Pending.java
fileNodes.summary: Package-private in-flight request holder pairing a Request with its own CompletableFuture result slot, plus the stamped command and a refused flag set by the writer thread.

fileNodes.name: Replay.java
fileNodes.summary: Rebuilds the Ledger from a snapshot plus the journal in two passes: verifies sequence/timestamp continuity and collects skips, then feeds non-skipped commands and checks every CHECK digest for divergence.

fileNodes.name: CommandJournal.java
fileNodes.summary: The write-ahead command journal: locks the file, validates the header and rules version, cuts torn tails, appends batches with one write and one fsync, reads records back, and fail-stops after any I/O error.

fileNodes.name: JournalCodec.java
fileNodes.summary: Text codec for journal format v3: encodes and decodes HEADER, NEW, CANCEL, CANCEL_ALL, SKIP and CHECK records, each sealed with a CRC-32C checksum, rebuilding requests through OrderRequest factories.

fileNodes.name: ReplayTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Tests Replay's verification pass (gaps, repeats, backwards timestamps, missing snapshot), feeding pass (skips, stopBefore, rebuild) and CHECK digest comparison.

fileNodes.name: CommandJournalTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Tests CommandJournal header handling, append/read round trips, torn-tail recovery, corrupt-record refusal, cross-process exclusivity and fail-stop behaviour.

fileNodes.name: JournalCodecTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Tests JournalCodec round trips for every record kind and header, exact sealed wire text, and rejection of corrupt, CRLF or checksum-failing records.

fileNodes.name: Fill.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable record describing what OrderBook.fillBest did to one resting order, so the matching engine learns fill details without holding the live Order object from the book.

fileNodes.name: RestingOrderView.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable snapshot of one resting order used to read the book without exposing the mutable Order; serves the engine's fillability walk, cancel-all and snapshot persistence (D67, D71, D72).

fileNodes.name: Snapshot.java
fileNodes.summary: Persistent exchange state after a given sequence number (D71): writes and reads the checksummed '<journal>.snapshot-<seq>' file of SNAPSHOT/ORDER/OSEQ/END records so recovery can start mid-history instead of replaying from sequence 1.

fileNodes.name: OrderType.java
fileNodes.summary: Enumeration of supported order types (LIMIT, IOC, FOK, MARKET, POST_ONLY) with documented matching semantics, and the rule for which types may rest on the book.

fileNodes.name: Side.java
fileNodes.summary: Enumeration of order sides (BUY, SELL) with an opposite() helper used throughout matching and book code.

fileNodes.name: EngineState.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable record of everything the matching engine needs to continue after a snapshot (D71): last sequence number, last order id, price-band reference price, and resting orders in book priority.

fileNodes.name: ClientMessage.java
fileNodes.summary: Sealed interface of parsed client protocol messages (Login, NewOrder, Cancel, Resend, Subscribe, Unsubscribe, Ping, Quit); syntax only, the session later adds the participant and builds the OrderRequest.

fileNodes.name: Checksums.java
fileNodes.summary: Shared CRC-32C checksum helper (D69) used to seal every journal and snapshot record as 8 lowercase hex digits of the record's UTF-8 text.

fileNodes.name: PriceLevelTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Unit tests for PriceLevel's intrusive doubly-linked order queue: add ordering, head fills, unlinking (including foreign and sentinel nodes) and node walking, checking forward and backward walks agree.

fileNodes.name: SnapshotTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Unit tests for Snapshot file round-tripping and corruption detection: changed characters, truncation, inconsistent END records, missing files and the empty starting snapshot.

fileNodes.name: ResponseTest.java
fileNodes.summary: Unit tests for Response constructor consistency checks (D22): status vs. filled/remaining quantities, reason and self-trade-prevention pairing, defensive copy of trades, and Trade field validation.

fileNodes.name: Main.java
fileNodes.summary: Command-line entry point that parses options, runs operator tools (--add-user, --quarantine, --compact), or loads credentials, binds the TCP/TLS gateway and starts the ExchangeService writer; maps failures to exit codes 0/1/2 with fail-stop on halt.

fileNodes.name: ClientMain.java
fileNodes.summary: Interactive console client that connects to the gateway (optionally over TLS with a truststore), forwards typed protocol lines and prints every server line as it arrives.

fileNodes.name: Sequencer.java
fileNodes.summary: The only component that reads the clock and counts: stamps new orders, cancels, cancel-alls, CHECK and SKIP records with sequence numbers, order ids and non-decreasing timestamps so everything downstream stays deterministic.

fileNodes.name: Exchange.java
fileNodes.summary: Core single-writer pipeline: stamps each batch with the Sequencer, appends it to the CommandJournal with one fsync, applies it to the Ledger, notifies the OutputListener and completes futures; also handles recovery/replay with CHECK digests, poison-pill quarantine and offline compaction.

fileNodes.name: ReplayException.java
fileNodes.summary: Exception raised when replay cannot rebuild state at a known record, distinguishing an ENGINE_FAILURE poison pill from a DIVERGED CHECK digest so the operator gets the right advice.

fileNodes.name: Credentials.java
fileNodes.summary: Immutable participant credential store backed by a users file of salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 hashes; verifies secrets in constant time and rewrites the file atomically when adding users.

fileNodes.name: Tls.java
fileNodes.summary: Builds optional TLS SSLContexts for the gateway server (PKCS#12 keystore) and client (truststore), reading passwords only from environment variables.

fileNodes.name: Durable.java
fileNodes.summary: Crash-safe file helpers: atomic write via temp file, fsync and rename, durable copy, and directory fsync so new directory entries survive a crash.

fileNodes.name: JournalLock.java
fileNodes.summary: Per-journal exclusive ownership lock on a separate <journal>.lock file, guarding against both other processes (OS file lock) and a second acquire in the same JVM.
